canada.title: Philanthropy will play role in federal government's plan to end homelessness in Winnipeg: finance minister
canada.summary: Canada's finance minister says private money has a role to play in making the government's $1-billion plan to end homelessness in Winnipeg a success.

canada.title: Camrose police investigation into disturbing social media posts targeting high school girls ends in no charges
canada.summary: The Camrose Police Service says no criminal charges will be laid after disturbing messages aimed at several female high school students circulated online earlier this year.

canada.title: From the battlefield to barriers at home: Remembering Indigenous veterans in Yellowknife
canada.summary: A Remembrance Day ceremony in Yellowknife honoured First Nations, Inuit and Métis Peoples who fought for Canada in war time.

canada.title: Wartime mystery solved as divers find wreck of ship torpedoed by German U-boat
canada.summary: The steamboat was heading from Barbados to New Brunswick in December 1944 when it was torpedoed by a German U-boat. Its wreckage was found this year.

canada.title: Quebec won't bail out CF Montreal, premier says, after news that owner will sell team
canada.summary: The government won't simply provide subsidies, Premier Paul St-Pierre Plamondon said on Tuesday, but he is open to studying proposals as owner Joey Saputo begins the process of selling the Major League Soccer club.

canada.title: Sexton Lumber shutdown ‘affects everybody’: N.L. forestry association
canada.summary: Sexton Lumber could lose eight to 12 per cent of its annual operations as a result of a fire almost two weeks ago, according to the Newfoundland and Labrador Forestry Industry Association.

canada.title: Dead body found in Surrey identified as that of missing 19-year-old man
canada.summary: In a statement, police said 19-year-old Tichic Meya was reported missing by his father just three days before the body was located by the Surrey Police Service on Oct. 14.

canada.title: Australia’s inaugural Ambassador for First Nations People visits Canada
canada.summary: Justin Mohamed, the inaugural ambassador for First Nations People in Australia visits Canada and sits down Face to Face.

canada.title: Tensions between PM, Quebec premier continue to flare in new tiff over U.S. relations
canada.summary: Premier Paul St-Pierre Plamondon sent letters to U.S. elected officials, as part of his intention to negotiate directly with American states. The move appeared to irritate Prime Minister Mark Carney, who said, "in a negotiation, it's always a good idea to have a single negotiator."

canada.title: RCMP search suspended for missing canoeist off Vancouver Island while community-led search continues
canada.summary: A police search for missing canoeist James "Dakota" Smith off northern Vancouver Island has been suspended as RCMP say challenging weather has made the chance of his survival unlikely. The Ma’amtagila Tribe Society is continuing their search for Smith and are calling for a coordinated, resourced search operation.

canada.title: CAO institutes discretionary spending freeze in CBRM to avoid cuts
canada.summary: According to the latest financial statement, spending in the public works department is already $1.8 million over budget and several other budgets are over as well.

canada.title: Stellantis plant sale: New employment program aims to help laid-off Brampton workers
canada.summary: With thousands of Brampton autoworkers facing an uncertain future, a new regional initiative is fast-tracking pathways into logistics and manufacturing across the Pearson Economic Zone.

canada.title: N.S. group apologizes for including woman convicted in a brutal killing on a panel
canada.summary: The Elizabeth Fry Society of Mainland Nova Scotia is apologizing after it hosted a panel discussion on violence that featured Marissa Shephard. Shephard was sentenced to 12 years in jail after she pleaded guilty to manslaughter and arson in the death of Baylee Wylie.

canada.title: Still no resolution for Corner Brook Civic Centre workers following negotiations
canada.summary: The City of Corner Brook and the union representing its Civic Centre employees have failed to reach an agreement, three weeks into a lockout.

canada.title: Four grizzly bears involved in deadly attack on mother and daughter in B.C.
canada.summary: The B.C. Conservation Officer Service says four grizzly bears that it captured in Bella Coola in recent days were all involved in a deadly attack that claimed the lives of a mother and daughter in the community this month.

canada.title: What's open and closed on Remembrance Day in Winnipeg
canada.summary: Some businesses, services and organizations will be closed or operating at reduced hours for Remembrance Day on Wednesday. Here's a look at what's open and closed in Winnipeg.

canada.title: Halifax man charged for allegedly spiking woman's drink at downtown bar
canada.summary: Police arrived at Durty Nelly's Irish Pub on Argyle Street early Saturday morning and found an unresponsive woman who had become ill after consuming a drink that a man was seen giving her.

canada.title: ‘Things will never be the same’: Wainwright prepares for Remembrance Day after fire
canada.summary: The Alberta town of Wainwright is gearing up for what could be the most solemn Remembrance Day in its recent history, says Mayor Bruce Pugh.
